006package dev.metaschema.cli.processor.completion;
007
008import java.io.File;
009import java.net.URI;
010import java.net.URL;
011import java.util.Arrays;
012import java.util.Map;
013import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
014import java.util.stream.Collectors;
015
016import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
018import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
019
020/**
021 * Registry for mapping Java types to their shell completion behavior.
022 * <p>
023 * This decouples type classes from completion logic, allowing any type to have
024 * completion behavior registered without implementing an interface.
025 * <p>
026 * Built-in types ({@link File}, {@link URI}, {@link URL}) are pre-registered.
027 * Custom types can be registered using
028 * {@link #register(Class, ICompletionType)} or {@link #registerEnum(Class)} for
029 * enum types.
030 */
031public final class CompletionTypeRegistry {
032  private static final Map<Class<?>, ICompletionType> REGISTRY = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
033
034  // Pre-register built-in types
035  static {
036    register(File.class, new FileCompletionType());
037    register(URI.class, new UriCompletionType());
038    register(URL.class, new UriCompletionType());
039  }
040
041  private CompletionTypeRegistry() {
042    // static utility class
043  }
044
045  /**
046   * Register a completion type for a class.
047   *
048   * @param type
049   *          the type class to register
050   * @param completion
051   *          the completion behavior for that type
052   */
053  public static void register(@NonNull Class<?> type, @NonNull ICompletionType completion) {
054    REGISTRY.put(type, completion);
055  }
056
057  /**
058   * Register an enum type using its constant names as completion values.
059   * <p>
060   * Enum names are converted to lowercase for completion.
061   *
062   * @param <E>
063   *          the enum type
064   * @param enumClass
065   *          the enum class to register
066   */
067  public static <E extends Enum<E>> void registerEnum(@NonNull Class<E> enumClass) {
068    register(enumClass, forEnum(enumClass));
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Create a completion type for an enum using its constant names.
073   * <p>
074   * Enum names are converted to lowercase for completion.
075   *
076   * @param <E>
077   *          the enum type
078   * @param enumClass
079   *          the enum class
080   * @return completion type that offers enum values
081   */
082  @NonNull
083  public static <E extends Enum<E>> ICompletionType forEnum(@NonNull Class<E> enumClass) {
084    String values = ObjectUtils.notNull(Arrays.stream(enumClass.getEnumConstants())
085        .map(Enum::name)
086        .map(String::toLowerCase)
087        .collect(Collectors.joining(" ")));
088
089    return new EnumCompletionType(values);
090  }
091
092  /**
093   * Lookup the completion type for a class.
094   *
095   * @param type
096   *          the type class to lookup
097   * @return the registered completion type, or {@code null} if none registered
098   */
099  @Nullable
100  public static ICompletionType lookup(@Nullable Class<?> type) {
101    return type == null ? null : REGISTRY.get(type);
102  }
103
104  /**
105   * Built-in completion type for file paths.
106   */
107  private static final class FileCompletionType implements ICompletionType {
108    @Override
109    public String getBashCompletion() {
110      return "_filedir";
111    }
112
113    @Override
114    public String getZshCompletion() {
115      return "_files";
116    }
117  }
118
119  /**
120   * Built-in completion type for URIs/URLs.
121   */
122  private static final class UriCompletionType implements ICompletionType {
123    @Override
124    public String getBashCompletion() {
125      return ""; // freeform in bash
126    }
127
128    @Override
129    public String getZshCompletion() {
130      return "_urls";
131    }
132  }
133
134  /**
135   * Completion type for enum values.
136   */
137  private static final class EnumCompletionType implements ICompletionType {
138    @NonNull
139    private final String values;
140
141    EnumCompletionType(@NonNull String values) {
142      this.values = values;
143    }
144
145    @Override
146    public String getBashCompletion() {
147      return "compgen -W \"" + values + "\"";
148    }
149
150    @Override
151    public String getZshCompletion() {
152      return "(" + values + ")";
153    }
154  }
155}
